festival_bonuses_dates_ck.name: festival_bonuses_dates_ck

        and "salary_deductions"."mobile_bill" >= 0 and "salary_deductions"."food_bill" >= 0 and "salary_deductions"."loan" >= 0 and "salary_deductions"."advance_salary" >= 0

salary_overtimes_amounts_ck.name: salary_overtimes_amounts_ck
salary_overtimes_amounts_ck.value:
"salary_overtimes"."days" between 0 and 31 and "salary_overtimes"."hours" between 0 and 744 and "salary_overtimes"."amount" >= 0
        and ("salary_overtimes"."hours" > 0 or "salary_overtimes"."amount" > 0)

salary_policies_percent_ck.name: salary_policies_percent_ck

"salary_policies"."basic_percent_of_gross" between 0 and 100 and "salary_policies"."house_rent_percent_of_basic" between 0 and 100
        and "salary_policies"."medical_percent_of_basic" between 0 and 100 and "salary_policies"."pf_percent_of_basic" between 0 and 100
        and "salary_policies"."cpf_percent_of_basic" between 0 and 100

salary_stops_start_ck.name: salary_stops_start_ck
salary_stops_start_ck.value:
("salary_stops"."start_year" is null and "salary_stops"."start_month" is null) or ("salary_stops"."start_month" between 1 and 12
        and "salary_stops"."start_year" * 12 + "salary_stops"."start_month" >= "salary_stops"."stop_year" * 12 + "salary_stops"."stop_month")

staff_salaries_amounts_ck.name: staff_salaries_amounts_ck

"staff_salaries"."basic" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."house_rent" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."medical" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."conveyance" >= 0
        and "staff_salaries"."other_allowance" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."pf" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."cpf" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."special_allowance" >= 0
        and "staff_salaries"."other_fixed" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."overtime_rate_per_hour" >= 0 and "staff_salaries"."taxable_amount" >= 0
